title: California Politicians Won't Be Able to Launch Meme Coins. Newsom Just Signed the Ban
summary: Governor Gavin Newsom signed Assembly Bill (AB) 2409 on September 27, barring California public officials from issuing meme coins. The law also stops crypto platforms from selling Californians new meme coins tied to public officials. Newsom’s office pitched the package as a contrast to President Donald Trump’s own token. title: Vitalik Buterin Says Next Year's Hegota Will Be Ethereum's Last ‘Normal' Fork
